data.gender_notes: Berthold is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Brave in battle, bold in heart
data.long_meaning: From the Old German 'beraht', meaning bright or famous. The name Berthold was given to infants born into noble families who were strong and brave in battle. The name Berthold carries the meaning “Brave in battle, bold in heart” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Berthold usually hope their child will grow to embody brave in battle, bold in heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_hebrew.name: ברטהולד
in_hebrew.meaning: נורו של ברטהולד פירושו שועל חכמה או תושיה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם ברטהולד מורכב משתי מילים גרמניות עתיקות 'ברת' שפירושה 'נורו' ו'הולד' שפירושה 'שועל' או 'חכם'. השם נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים והוא נושא משמעות של שועל חכם או נורו של תושיה. השם ברטהולד שימש בקרב הימורים והיה פופולרי בגרמניה ובהונגריה.

in_greek.name: Βερολδός
in_greek.meaning: Βερολδός σημαίνει ισχυρός ή φίλος της φωτιάς
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Βερολδός είναι γερμανικής προέλευσης και σημαίνει ισχυρός ή φίλος της φωτιάς. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις γερμανικές λέξεις 'beraht' που σημαίνει φωτεινός και 'wald' που σημαίνει δάσος ή κυριαρχία. Το όνομα Βερολδός ήταν δημοφιλές στην Ευρώπη κατά τη Μεσαίωνα και χρησιμοποιήθηκε από πολλούς βασιλιάδες και ευγενείς.

in_latin.name: Berthold
in_latin.meaning: Berthold means bright ruler or famous lord
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Berthold is derived from Old High German words 'beraht' meaning bright and 'wald' meaning rule or power. The name Berthold was popularized in Europe during the Middle Ages and was borne by several saints and nobles, including Saint Berthold of Regensburg, a 13th-century German priest and reformer.

in_english.name: Berthold
in_english.meaning: Berthold means bright ruler or famous lord with strength
in_english.long_meaning: The name Berthold originates from Old High German words 'beraht' meaning bright and 'wald' meaning rule or power. Berthold symbolizes leadership, wisdom, and spiritual strength, reflecting its etymological roots in brightness and rulership.

The name Berthold was often associated with military prowess and leadership abilities. Berlin Cathedral, which was named after Prince-Bishop Berthold von Hohenzollern, is an impressive example of the cultural influence the name Berthold had during the medieval era.
